subject: Training on customer data: opt-out confirmation / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finserve.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Training on customer data: opt-out confirmation / next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate you walking us through FinServe's use case and the sensitive data points in your flows. Per our discussion, I wanted to recap the specific data handling and privacy controls we covered and confirm the opt-out for "training-on-customer-data / model improvements."

Recap from today's discovery: 
- PII types: account numbers, SSNs (masked), and transaction descriptions that may include sensitive identifiers.
- Data retention target: logs retained for 90 days, aggregated telemetry for 12 months.
- Logging controls: request-level logging turned off for production heuristic routes; request metadata (latency/errors) retained.
- Data residency: primary region us-west-2, with no cross-region replication for raw request content.
- Opt-out ask: FinServe requires all production request payloads be excluded from model training and improvement pipelines (no use for tuning, embeddings retraining, or annotation).

Next steps I propose: 
1) I'll send a formal confirmation email that we will mark the FinServe account as "training-opt-out" in our platform and apply the logging/retention settings discussed.
2) Security will send a short checklist for our audit record (cc Neha).
3) If you want the SOW updated with the opt-out clause, attach the draft and we'll coordinate redlines.

I've attached our Redwood_Data_Handling_FAQ.pdf for quick reference on how opt-outs are implemented and the limitations for certain features (e.g., aggregated telemetry).

Please reply to confirm the opt-out wording below or flag any adjustments: 

"FinServe requests that Redwood Inference not use any production request payloads, responses, or derived embeddings from the FinServe production environment for model training, tuning, or improvement. Redwood will restrict storage of raw request bodies to the retention window of 90 days and ensure region-limited storage as described."

If that language looks good, I'll mark the account and loop in Legal to update the SOW.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Data_Handling_FAQ.pdf (overview, implementation notes)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finserve.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinServe Legal <legal@finserve.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Training on customer data: opt-out confirmation / next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the FAQ — that's helpful. The proposed opt-out wording is acceptable to us. A couple of small clarifications from Legal: 
- Please confirm that embeddings & derived vectors generated from production traffic will not be used for any model retraining or shared with third-party annotators.
- Confirm retention enforcement: raw request bodies will be deleted after 90 days; logs that are necessary for debugging (non-content metadata) may be kept for 12 months.

If you can confirm both points in writing we'll be fine to proceed. I'll also attach a copy of the SOW draft (FinServe_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf) with a placeholder clause for the opt-out.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Engineering, FinServe Inc.
alex.johnson@finserve.com | +1 (212) 555-0143

Attachment: FinServe_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finserve.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, FinServe Legal <legal@finserve.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Training on customer data: opt-out confirmation / next steps

Hi Alex —

Confirming both items: 
1) Embeddings / derived vectors: Redwood will not use embeddings or any derived vectors from FinServe production traffic for model retraining, tuning, or annotation pipelines. That material will be excluded from any improvement datasets.
2) Retention enforcement: Raw request bodies will be deleted after 90 days. Operational telemetry and non-content logs used for debugging and SLO monitoring may be retained up to 12 months, but will not include full request payloads.

We will mark the FinServe account with the internal flag "training-opt-out" and apply the configuration to your production routes. Neha (cc'd) from Security will add a short attestation file to our records and provide the audit checklist for your team.

Next: I'll send the updated SOW language to Legal (DocuSign link below) once we get your sign-off on the attached draft.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/sign?d=ABC123
HubSpot: HUBSPOT-7554123

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you prefer verbal confirmation.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
